scenes.title: Christina Maslach confronting Superintendent Zimbardo in the Jordan Hall basement corridor beside mirrored-sunglass guards on Day 5
scenes.era: August 1971, Jordan Hall Psychology Basement, Stanford University

layout.description: Brightly lit windowless 1971 university basement hallway converted into 'Stanford County Jail' with painted drywall doors labeled 'The Yard', a superintendent clipboard desk, khaki-uniformed guard mannequins in silver mirrored aviator sunglasses, and numbered smock uniforms.

positions.who: Christina Maslach (mannequin in 1971 tailored jacket and blouse)
positions.where: standing firmly in the bright corridor raising an open palm to halt the superintendent's roll-call clipboard

positions.who: Philip Zimbardo as 'Superintendent' (mannequin in 1971 dark suit holding timetable clipboard)
positions.where: freezing mid-step as his dual researcher/warden blind spot cracks open

positions.who: Two Guard mannequins (in khaki shirts, whistles, and silver mirrored sunglasses)
positions.where: standing uncertainly down the corridor beside cell door #1

props.name: silver mirrored aviator sunglasses
props.period_detail: reflective 1971 sunglasses worn by guards to hide eye-to-eye human contact
props.physical_behavior: held lowered in one guard's hand as the spell breaks

props.name: Day-6 'STUDY TERMINATED' calendar & orientation tape reel
props.period_detail: wall schedule crossed out at Day 6 of 14 alongside the open orientation briefing notes
props.physical_behavior: documents both the rapid escalation and the staff briefing cues

props.name: 'Stanford County Jail' painted hallway sign
props.period_detail: hand-lettered 1971 placard taped over the Jordan Hall psychology basement door
props.physical_behavior: shows the makeshift academic corridor beneath the theatrical roles

actions.verb_sequence: steps into the brightly lit basement hallway -> points from the mirrored sunglasses and numbered smocks to the researcher's clipboard -> demands the simulation stop
lowers his superintendent clipboard -> crosses out Days 7 through 14 on the wall schedule

reactions.reaction: removes the silver mirrored sunglasses, snapping instantly back into an ordinary college student
stands steady as the sole visitor out of fifty to break institutional tunnel vision

scenes.wardrobe: 1971 Stanford attire: khaki short-sleeve button shirts and chinos on guards; numbered cotton smocks on prisoners; Maslach in 1971 tailored blazer; Zimbardo in dark 1971 slacks and shirt.
scenes.lighting: Bright high-key fluorescent basement corridor lighting — clean documentary visibility with zero dark horror gloom.
scenes.recognition_hook: Fifty visitors walked through Stanford's six-day basement prison and stayed quiet — until Christina Maslach stepped in on Day 5 and broke the superintendent's tunnel vision.

key_visual.description: a 1971 female psychologist confronting the study director in a brightly lit university basement hallway labeled 'Stanford County Jail' while a khaki-clad student lowers mirrored sunglasses

scenes.title: Sunday random lot draw sorting 24 screened students into two boxes

layout.description: Bright office table with two cardboard supply boxes labeled 'Guards (Khaki + Glasses)' and 'Prisoners (Numbered Smocks)'.

positions.where: sorting 24 identical healthy psychological screening folders into two equal stacks

props.name: 24 normal MMPI screening folders
props.physical_behavior: split arbitrarily into power vs powerlessness

actions.verb_sequence: places twelve folders beside the mirrored sunglasses box and twelve beside the numbered smock box

scenes.recognition_hook: Twenty-four healthy students with identical personality scores were split purely by chance.

scenes.title: 2018 Archival Discovery: Orientation briefing script on the desk

layout.description: Sunlit modern university archive table displaying typed 1971 orientation transcripts highlighting Warden Jaffe's coaching lines.

positions.where: comparing the 1971 orientation transcript against textbook summaries with a highlighter

props.name: 1971 orientation transcript binder
props.period_detail: printed archival pages highlighting 'create a sense of powerlessness'
props.physical_behavior: proves leadership coaching drove escalation alongside uniforms

actions.verb_sequence: underlines the explicit guard-coaching lines and notes that two-thirds of guards still resisted cruelty

reactions.reaction: nods as the fuller scientific truth emerges

scenes.recognition_hook: Uncovered 1971 transcripts proved guards didn't turn cruel in a vacuum — leaders coached them 'for the sake of science.'

scenes.title: Modern Institutional Review Board (IRB) independent safety check

layout.description: Sunlit oak table where an independent ethics panel reviews a study protocol while the lead researcher sits across the table rather than chairing.

positions.where: stamping an independent monitoring requirement onto a protocol folder

props.name: IRB Independent Monitor checklist
props.physical_behavior: separates investigator ambition from participant safety

actions.verb_sequence: assigns an external safety officer with unilateral stop authority

scenes.recognition_hook: Modern ethics boards exist because no leader can objectively police a hierarchy they are starring in.
